stock_movements_sign_check.name: stock_movements_sign_check
stock_movements_sign_check.value:
("stock_movements"."type" in ('opening', 'purchase', 'sale_reversal') and "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" > 0)
        or ("stock_movements"."type" in ('sale', 'purchase_void', 'wastage') and "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" < 0)
        or ("stock_movements"."type" = 'adjustment')

orders_paid_consistency_check.name: orders_paid_consistency_check
orders_paid_consistency_check.value:
("orders"."status" = 'completed' and "orders"."paid_at" is not null and "orders"."payment_method" is not null)
        or ("orders"."status" = 'pending' and "orders"."paid_at" is null)
        or ("orders"."status" = 'cancelled')
